title: Design System: Project Amazon PH Academy v2

display.purpose: Page and section headings, control labels, and table headers.

body.purpose: Default reading copy and form text.

label.purpose: Buttons, form labels, navigation items, and table headers.

mono.purpose: Tabular numbers, bid values, hashes, identifiers, and code.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and active color transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-emphasis action with navy text on Amazon Orange, compact 40px height, and an accessible orange focus ring.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; min-height:40px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 16px; font-family:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:13px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; transition:background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.3,1),transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.3,1),box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,153,0,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary { background:#FF9900; border-color:#FF9900; color:#131921; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#FFA41C; border-color:#FFA41C; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,17,17,0.08); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered work-surface action beside a primary control.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background:#FFFFFF; color:#007185; border:1px solid #485769; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#E7F3F4; border-color:#007185; color:#054A5A; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent, lowest-emphasis action that retains a visible focus treatment.

components.name: Default Card
components.description: Work-surface card with a standard border and restrained resting elevation.
components.html:
Module 3: Bid Strategy

Learn how to read search term reports and adjust bids with confidence.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid #D5D9D9; border-radius:8px; padding:16px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,17,17,0.08); font-family:'PT Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; transition:border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.3,1),transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.3,1),box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.3,1); } .ds-card-title { font-family:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:18px; font-weight:700; color:#232F3E; margin-bottom:8px; } .ds-card-body { font-size:14px; color:#565959; line-height:1.55; }

components.name: Interactive Card
components.description: Clickable card with a gentle hover lift, orange-tinted border, and strengthened elevation.
components.html:
Campaign Builder

Practice building a Sponsored Products campaign end to end.
components.css: .ds-card-interactive { cursor:pointer; } .ds-card-interactive:hover { border-color:#FCE3C2; transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(15,17,17,0.10); } .ds-card-interactive:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,153,0,0.35); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: White work-surface field with a standard border, 40px height, and orange focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; font-family:'PT Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-label { font-family:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; color:#232F3E; } .ds-input { height:40px; padding:0 12px; background:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid #D5D9D9; border-radius:6px; color:#0F1111; outline:none; transition:border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.3,1),box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.3,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#B1B6BC; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:#9B3E00; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,153,0,0.35); }

components.name: Accent Badge
components.description: Compact selected-context chip with readable dark orange text on a soft orange surface.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:24px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:999px; font-family:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; background:#FEF3E7; color:#9B3E00; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Navy-shell navigation row with orange selected state and leading indicator.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:40px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:6px; color:#99A5B4; font-family:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; transition:background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.3,1),color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color:#E9EFF8; } .ds-nav-item-active { background:rgba(255,153,0,0.08); border-color:rgba(255,153,0,0.30); color:#FF9900; font-weight:700; } .ds-nav-icon { width:20px; height:20px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:10px; }

narrative.overview: This system is an operational training interface: a navy global shell, cool-gray work canvas, white cards, compact controls, and Amazon Orange reserved for primary action and selected context. It is designed for fast scanning and confident decisions across lessons, simulators, and administration. The interface uses soft, purposeful elevation to establish work-surface hierarchy, with semantic colors supporting success, warning, error, and information states. Decorative print effects, warm-paper metaphors, and unrelated visual languages are outside the system.
keyCharacteristics: Navy shell chrome with cool work surfaces and white cards
Amazon Orange for primary action, focus, and selected context
Archivo for headings and controls, PT Sans for body copy, IBM Plex Mono for data
Subtle resting elevation with stronger interactive elevation
Compact, accessible controls with 44px mobile targets where touch is primary

rules.name: Action Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use Amazon Orange for the local primary action, active navigation, keyboard focus, and selected state. Supporting actions use blue or neutral work-surface treatments.

rules.name: Accessible Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use dark navy text on Amazon Orange controls and the dark-orange token for orange text on light surfaces. Verify contrast instead of assuming a conventional color pairing is accessible.

rules.name: Defined Type Roles Rule
rules.body: Archivo establishes hierarchy and controls, PT Sans supports reading, and IBM Plex Mono is reserved for fixed-width data. Do not introduce substitute global typefaces.

rules.name: Controlled Elevation Rule
rules.body: Cards and panels use a subtle resting shadow; interactive elements strengthen elevation only when a state change communicates affordance.

dos: Do use the navy shell, cool-gray work canvas, white cards, and Amazon Orange primary actions.
Do use the shared four-pixel spacing scale and 4–12px radius family.
Do pair every semantic status with text, icon, and color where the state needs explanation.
Do keep touch-critical targets at least 44×44px on mobile and preserve a visible orange focus ring.
Do use restrained elevation to clarify card and overlay hierarchy.
donts: Don't add warm-paper textures, print motifs, decorative noise, or arbitrary visual metaphors.
Don't use glassmorphism, gradient orbs, cyan-on-dark neon accents, or decorative motion.
Don't create oversized marketing whitespace or generic portfolio-style hero treatment.
Don't use font weight 800 or 900 for hierarchy.
Don't put white text on the primary orange button or introduce hard-coded component palettes.
